sections.description: The DIY Handmade theme provides a clean and organized layout for presenting handmade products, creative collections, and craft-related content. It includes a responsive design that adapts to different screen sizes for consistent viewing across desktops, tablets, and mobile devices. The homepage supports customizable sections for featured products, categories, banners, and image galleries. Built-in customization options allow changes to colors, typography, layouts, logos, and menus through the theme settings without editing core files. The theme is compatible with popular page builders and supports standard customization features for flexible page creation. It also includes social media integration, navigation menus, widget-ready areas, and blog layouts for publishing updates or creative articles. The code follows current development standards and is designed for reliable performance and maintainability. Translation support and basic accessibility features help improve usability for different audiences. The overall structure focuses on clear navigation, organized content presentation, and straightforward customization. Regular theme updates and compatibility with commonly used plugins help maintain functionality while providing a practical foundation for creating a handmade-focused website with a simple and consistent design.
